findings.title: [P0] Restore the `RequestOptions` export removed from types.ts
findings.body: This diff deletes `export interface RequestOptions { timeoutMs: number }` from `src/types.ts`, but `src/client.ts:1` still contains `import { RequestOptions, ClientOptions } from "./types"` and line 3 uses `RequestOptions` as the type of the `options` parameter of the exported `request()`. Since `./types` no longer exports that member, any TypeScript build of `client.ts` fails with `TS2305: Module '"./types"' has no exported member 'RequestOptions'` — the change breaks compilation regardless of input. Restore the `RequestOptions` interface in `src/types.ts` (or, if its removal is intentional, rewrite `request()`'s signature and delete the import). While fixing the import line, note that the newly added `ClientOptions` import in `client.ts` is currently unused.
